list.name: tpmerc
list.label: Market type
list.query: Cash (010) : 010, Odd lot (020) : 020, Call exercise (012) : 012, Put exercise (013) : 013, Auction (017) : 017, Forward (030) : 030, Futures with gain retention (050) : 050, Futures with movement (060) : 060, Call options (070) : 070, Put options (080) : 080

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker
list.query:
SELECT codneg
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY codneg
ORDER BY sum(voltot) DESC
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Total volume
panels.description: Total BRL volume of the selected tickers in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(voltot) AS volume
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Total trades
panels.description: Total number of trades of the selected tickers in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(totneg)::BIGINT AS trades
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Instruments traded
panels.description: How many of the selected tickers traded in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT codneg) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Trading days
panels.description: Trading days with at least one selected ticker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT dtpreg) AS days
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Close price
panels.description: Daily closing price per selected ticker (BRL, not adjusted).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dtpreg::TIMESTAMP AS time, codneg AS ticker, arg_max(preult, voltot) AS close
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Return since start of range
panels.description: Close relative to each ticker's first close in the range, to compare tickers on one scale.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT dtpreg::TIMESTAMP AS time, codneg AS ticker, arg_max(preult, voltot) AS close
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
    AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
    AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, ticker, close / first_value(close) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY time) - 1 AS return
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Daily change
panels.description: Close vs the previous trading day's close, per selected ticker.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT dtpreg::TIMESTAMP AS time, codneg AS ticker, arg_max(preult, voltot) AS close
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
    AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
    AND dtpreg::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND dtpreg::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY ALL
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, ticker, close / lag(close) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY time) - 1 AS change
  FROM daily
)
SELECT time, ticker, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Daily range (high vs low)
panels.description: Daily high over low minus 1 per selected ticker, a simple intraday volatility measure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dtpreg::TIMESTAMP AS time, codneg AS ticker, max(premax) / nullif(min(premin), 0) - 1 AS range
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Daily volume by market
panels.description: Daily BRL volume of the selected tickers per market type; ignores the market type filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  dtpreg::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc = '010') AS "Cash",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc = '020') AS "Odd lot",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc IN ('070', '080')) AS "Options",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc IN ('012', '013')) AS "Option exercise",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc = '030') AS "Forward",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc = '017') AS "Auction",
  sum(voltot) FILTER (WHERE tpmerc IN ('050', '060')) AS "Futures"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg IN ($ticker)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 20 by volume (range)
panels.description: Top 20 tickers by BRL volume in the selected market types; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  codneg AS ticker,
  any_value(nomres) AS name,
  any_value(especi) AS spec,
  sum(totneg)::BIGINT AS trades,
  sum(voltot) AS volume,
  arg_min(preult, dtpreg) AS first_close,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) AS last_close,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) / arg_min(preult, dtpreg) - 1 AS period_return
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY codneg
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top gainers (avg R$ 1M/day)
panels.description: Top 15 period returns among tickers averaging BRL 1M/day in the selected market types; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  codneg AS ticker,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) AS last_close,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) / arg_min(preult, dtpreg) - 1 AS period_return
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY codneg
HAVING avg(voltot) >= 1000000
ORDER BY period_return DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top losers (avg R$ 1M/day)
panels.description: Bottom 15 period returns among tickers averaging BRL 1M/day in the selected market types; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  codneg AS ticker,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) AS last_close,
  arg_max(preult, dtpreg) / arg_min(preult, dtpreg) - 1 AS period_return
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY codneg
HAVING avg(voltot) >= 1000000
ORDER BY period_return ASC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: $ticker daily candles
panels.description: Daily candles with BRL volume, one panel per selected ticker (prices not adjusted).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  dtpreg::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  preabe AS open,
  premax AS high,
  premin AS low,
  preult AS close,
  voltot AS volume
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_history/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE codneg = $ticker
  AND tpmerc IN ($tpmerc)
  AND $__timeFilter(dtpreg::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time
